title: Taxi Tracker/Shift
text:
\define shift-start-filter() [tag[Shift]field:shift-type[Start]field:shift-date[$(asd)$]] \define shift-end-filter() [tag[Shift]field:shift-type[End]field:shift-date[$(asd)$]] \define tt-set-start() <$action-setfield $tiddler="$:/taxitracker/scratch/shift-type" $field="text" $value="Start"/> \end \define tt-set-end() <$action-setfield $tiddler="$:/taxitracker/scratch/shift-type" $field="text" $value="End"/> \end \define tt-do-save() <$action-sendmessage $message="tt-save-shift"/> \end \define tt-do-end() <$action-sendmessage $message="tt-end-shift"/> \end \define tt-do-close() <$action-sendmessage $message="tt-close-shift"/> \end \define tt-confirm-proceed() <$action-sendmessage $message="tt-confirm-proceed"/> \end \define tt-confirm-cancel() <$action-setfield $tiddler="$:/taxitracker/state/confirm-action" $field="text" $value=""/> <$action-setfield $tiddler="$:/taxitracker/state/confirm-msg" $field="text" $value=""/> \end !! Shift <$list filter="[[$:/taxitracker/state/confirm-action]get[text]minlength[1]]" emptyMessage="">
{{$:/taxitracker/state/confirm-msg}}
<$button actions=<> class="tt-popup-btn tt-popup-cash">Yes, proceed <$button actions=<> class="tt-popup-cancel">Cancel

''Active shift: '' {{$:/taxitracker/active-shift-date}} <$list filter=<> emptyMessage=""> Start: <$view field="shift-time"/> · Car: <$view field="car"/> <$list filter=<> emptyMessage=""> End: <$view field="shift-time"/> <$button actions=<> class="tt-clear-btn">Close Shift
Keeps data · resets for next shift
